message: The morning after hearing about the secret arts.

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve finally gotten used to this lifestyle.」
Waking up at 6:00, eating breakfast at the faculty cafeteria, and getting some light exercise. Once the time comes, I get ready and head to the classroom.
This routine has finally started to feel natural.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, time to do my best as a teacher today too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Good morning, everyone！ Time for roll call！」
I say that, even though there are only five of them and no real need for it.

name: Iori
message: 「...Wait, someone’s missing.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Teach, Momitchi isn’t here yet～」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm？ What happened to Momiji？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come to think of it, the light in Momiji’s room was still on until around 1:00 last night.」
...Could Momiji be oversleeping？

name: Iori
message: 「Actually, the fact that you know that means you were up late too, Asahi. What were you doing？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, just a bit of independent training.」

name: Iori
message: 「Training until 1:00 in the morning... you should take it easy, alright？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you for your concern.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, Momiji really is a handful...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Wouldn't it be fine to just leave her be? She is a scholarship student, after all, isn't she?」
It’s true; whether Momiji oversleeps or skips class, it doesn't cause any real problems for her grades.

name: Iori
message: 「No, that’s a separate issue. We made a promise, so I need her to attend class properly.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You really are earnest...」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m going to the dorms to wake Momiji up now. Everyone, please wait and do some self-study for a while.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Are you going to drag Momimomi back？ If so, I want to go too！ I’m going to be an enforcer！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh, I really wanted to avoid any trouble...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I haven't even done anything yet, so it’s rather insulting to be treated like a troublemaker.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think it would be better to take her along. Momiji is a woman, after all, and you never know what might happen.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right. That’s true.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then Setsugekka, while you're at it, please go dig up some dirt on Momiji.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Roger that！ Leave it to me！」

name: Iori
message: 「You guys...」
Well, I suppose it can't be helped. It's Momiji's fault for oversleeping.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey hey, open the door！ This is the Kazamine Police！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't start trouble three seconds after we arrive!」
I hurriedly pull Setsugekka away from the door.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, she's not waking up. I don't hear a sound either. Do you think she might've hated class so much that she ran away?」

name: Iori
message: 「I'd like to think that's not the case, but」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Should I try entering through the window like last time?」

name: Iori
message: 「No, knowing Momiji's personality, she's probably already taken precautions. The same trick won't work twice.」
It wouldn't even be surprising if she'd rigged up an electric shock trap.

name: Iori
message: 「Can't be helped, I'll use the master key.」
I use the key I'm holding to unlock the door.

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, just as I thought...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nn…………mu, nya…………zzzz, zzzz……」
In her characteristically messy room, the owner is fast asleep.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh~ look at that. She's sound asleep... So carefree, not even knowing what's about to be done to her~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So Sensei, what should I do？ Strip her？ Or maybe hang her upside down？」

name: Iori
message: 「Just wake her up without causing any injuries.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Roger that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey hey, get up already, you sleepyhead！ If you don't get up, I'm gonna play some nasty pranks on you~♪」
Setsugekka suddenly pounces and mounts Momiji. Control yourself, control yourself.

name: Momiji
message: 「Fwahh！？ Eh……eehh！？ Not again！？ Wait, how come Setsugekka is here！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh heh heh, it's okay if you want to keep sleeping？ I'll make you feel reaaally good, ei ei~♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「St-stop~, uhehehehe, ahhahahaha」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alrighty, time to momimomi Momimomi's boobs, momi momi momi……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eek！？ S-stop it, that tickles！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So soft… I knew Suzakuin was just built different~♪ Hehehehe…」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hnnnghh… w-wait, not there, nn-ahh, nn-uuh… kufuun!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka！ Quit that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, alright. How about this then？」
She began massaging her back with her thumbs.

name: Momiji
message: 「Fah… ah, that hits the spot… nnuuh, s-so good… ah, that’s nice… nnhooooo…」

name: Iori
message: 「…Yeah, Setsugekka. You should probably stop that too.」
Her voice sounds lewd regardless of what’s happening.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, don't you think it's time to wake up, Momimomi？ If you don't, I'll just do this… momimomimomimomi♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uwaaah… jeez, what are you, some kind of perverted old man? Seriously, cut it out already…！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright Setsugekka, she’s awake now, so that’s enough.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okaaay!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa, haa, haa… w-what is wrong with you two！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm? The Momimomi Wake-Up Squad?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ I have no idea what you’re talking about, but… you know, breaking into someone’s room to assault them is basically a crime, right！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, what time do you think it is？ Class started a long time ago.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh？ But I set my alarm properly… wait, it’s stopped！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Didn't you stop it yourself？」

name: Momiji
message: 「…Sleeping in is just the best, isn’t it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s fine if I sleep in every once in a while. I’m a scholarship student; it’s not like I’m obligated to go to every class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, that settles it—I’m taking the day off.」

name: Iori
message: 「No way. I’m not letting you skip. You’re going to show up just like you promised.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ehh, you’re such a drag! Just let it slide this once, will ya~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I get it. So that’s why you’ve been hoping Muragaki-sensei would come wake you up every morning.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wha—！？ I’m not hoping for anything like that, and I’ve never even thought about it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I—It’s just that I’m not a morning person, I’m more of a night owl, so...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, so Momimomi isn’t a morning person. Weakness found.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, and by the way, I’m in a horrible mood when I first wake up. If you do anything weird again, I’ll legit kill you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, scary.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, that’s enough for today, isn’t it? I’m still sleepy, so please get out.」

name: Iori
message: 「Can’t be helped... Should I call Sasaki-sensei instead?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, what！？ Ugh, I really hate you, Iori-sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ll come to class, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, yes, I get it. I’m coming, I’m coming！」
Still, it would be a real pain if I had to deal with this every single morning... What should I do.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, are you a morning person？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m the kind of girl who wakes up when the sun comes out and gets sleepy the moment it sets.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, you’re a good girl, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, praise me more, praise me more~！」
If she’s a morning person, this might work out perfectly.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, from now on, on days when there’s class, could you come wake Momiji up for me?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? I don’t mind, but... I’m pretty sure Momimomi will lock her door and not let me in.」

name: Iori
message: 「It’ll be fine. I’ll give you the key to Momiji’s room.」

name: Momiji
message: 「H-Haaah！？ You’ve gotta be joking, right！？ What about my privacy！？」

name: Iori
message: 「No need to worry, it’s an electronic lock. I’ll make a limited-access key that only works on the mornings when we have class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s not the point~!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The job of dragging a sleepy Momimomi out of bed every morning... Hehehe, that actually sounds kind of fun.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, harassment isn’t cool, you know!」

name: Iori
message: 「Even so, if you won't get up on your own, someone's got to come wake you up.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Worst case, I can deal with Sensei, just spare me Setsugekka...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, what's that supposed to mean?! You got a problem with me?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because you always do weird things to me!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, that's just how I show affection.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't think an excuse like that justifies sexual harassment!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm... I see. Well, maybe I'll ask Asahi then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi wouldn't sexually harass you, right? Does that work for you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, if you hand Asahi-chan a room key, every last one of her secrets will get exposed and it'll be a total disaster~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah... yes, Setsugekka is fine after all.」
Alright, she caved.

name: Iori
message: 「Then I'm counting on you starting tomorrow, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okaaay!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah, this is the woooorst...！」
Momiji clutched her head and looked up at the ceiling.
Momiji said she'd catch up as soon as she finished changing, so Setsugekka and I decided to head back to the classroom first.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「By the way, Sensei, there's something I've been wondering about.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm？ What's up？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Do you think... Momimomi hates me? She was acting kind of cold toward me earlier, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't think she hates you or anything.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji is a daughter of the Suzakuin family, after all. She's probably spent most of her life alone.」

name: Iori
message: 「I think she's just not very good at getting close to people and things like that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahh, now that you mention it, she does seem like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「So I'm hoping someone pushy like you can break through that wall for her, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see! So my job is to smash Momiji's stubborn heart to smithereens!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, don’t go breaking anything, okay? You two need to get along.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Understood! Just leave it all to me.」
If he allowed her to be selfish, Momiji would only become more and more isolated. It should be fine for her to have people reach out to her, even if it might be an annoyance.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, ‘getting along,’ huh.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s a bit strange, really. Kazamine and Suzakuin are both trying to be number one, yet here we are in the same Jindou class.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Is it really okay for me to get chummy with Momimomi~?」

name: Iori
message: 「I don’t know about the family business. But you’re both my students, that much is certain.」

name: Iori
message: 「In that case, wouldn’t it be fine for you both to at least acknowledge each other’s dedication to Jindou？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, I wonder if Momimomi will acknowledge me~」

name: Iori
message: 「You just need to become stronger, Setsugekka. If you do that, you can push each other to reach even greater heights.」

name: Iori
message: 「I had someone like that, too. We were always trying to catch up to and surpass one another.」

name: Iori
message: 「I believe I am who I am today because of that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehh~♪ So even Sensei had a rival！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, thinking back on it, it was fun. And, for the record, they were a flashy and loud nuisance.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, you’re an alumnus of this school, right? Did you pull any pranks back when you were a student?」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, well, I did a few things.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Did you, by chance, put a hole in the arena wall？ You did, right？ Tell me you did！」

name: Iori
message: 「Only someone like you would do something like that, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh~~!？ That’s not true! Someone will definitely do it! Someday, eventually, for sure!」

name: Iori
message: 「I can say with certainty that it would be you, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaaa~~！？ H-hey, stop with the weird prophecies！」

name: Iori
message: 「Good grief… hehe, hahaha.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahaha, so even Sensei laughs!」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, of course. Because you’re fun to be around, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah... wait, are you praising me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course I am.」
I wanted Setsugekka, with that dauntless cheerfulness of hers, to pull Momiji out of that room where she was all alone.
